name: Riverton phrasing robustness (dev) v1
purpose: Does search find the right file however a person phrases the question? Each target is a fact whose source files are known from the evidence; each is asked five ways: as the documents say it (doc), as a person would ask it (casual), with typos (typo), with nicknames or company jargon (nickname), and indirectly, by what the person is trying to do (indirect). A phrasing passes if any gold file is in the top 10. Written by the Brain side from evidence, as a measuring tool, not a target to tune on question by question.
